module_summary: Clock/reset generator: stretches the external reset with a down-counter, feeds a vendor PLL/MMCM (or passes XCLK through) and releases the internal reset via a second counter after LOCKED.

anchors.name: IRES
anchors.why: Reset-stretch down-counter on XCLK; IRES[7] resets the PLL and defines LOCKED in bypass.

anchors.name: LOCKED
anchors.why: PLL lock flag; while low it reloads DRES holding internal reset.

anchors.name: DRES
anchors.why: Down-counter on CLK delaying reset release after lock; MSB drives RES.

anchors.name: RES
anchors.why: Generated internal reset output synchronized to CLK from DRES[7].

anchors.name: XRES
anchors.why: External reset request reloading the IRES stretch counter.

groups.name: input_reset_stretch
groups.description: Stretches external reset XRES for PLL reset using IRES counter.

groups.name: clock_generator
groups.description: Vendor PLL/MMCM or bypass producing CLK and LOCKED from XCLK.

groups.name: output_reset_sync
groups.description: Holds RES asserted until DRES counts down after PLL lock.
